breakdown.description: Phase-change heat transfer is modeled with sensible heat cpΔT even though condensation involves latent heat with ΔT≈0.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the user's incorrect instruction to use the sensible heat formula (q = m cp ΔT) for a phase change process. Instead, it specified that the calculation will use the latent heat of vaporization (h_fg), which is the correct physical principle for condensation at a constant temperature, aligning perfectly with the ground truth.
